references.text: Describes the northern border of the promised land, including the area from Mount Hor to Lebo-Hamath, as mentioned in Joshua 13:5.
Mentions Mount Hermon (Baal-Hermon) as part of the territory Joshua conquered, the same mountain region described in Joshua 13:5.
Describes the area from Baal-Gad in the Valley of Lebanon at the foot of Mount Hermon, corresponding to the geography in Joshua 13:5.
Mentions Lebanon and Mount Hermon (Baal-Hermon) as parts of the unconquered land, consistent with Joshua 13:5.
Mentions Lebo-Hamath as the northern border of Israel's territory under Solomon, referring to the same area mentioned in Joshua 13:5.
Describes the northern border of the future promised land with Hamath as the northern boundary marker, corresponding to Joshua 13:5.
